- Barkley — large independent, strong on brand strategy and creative work.
- VML / VMLY&R — global network with broad capabilities in digital, advertising, and experience design.

If you tell me:
- What industry you’re in (B2B, consumer, healthcare, tech, etc.)
- The services you need (branding, digital ads, SEO, content, PR, social, etc.)
- Your monthly/annual budget range
- Whether you need local or national reach
I’ll put together a tailored shortlist of Kansas City agencies (small, mid-size, and large) with why each could be a fit, example case studies, and questions to ask them.
